tasks.title: Fix four tg- class-name typos: board.css styles no node touchdraw.js draws
tasks.why: P1. The new touchdraw block (board.css:196-304) carries four rules the script can never trigger, each a one-letter-prefix typo: board.css:217 `.tg-log li.t-pickable` (touchdraw.js:459,499 only ever add `tg-pickable`) carries `cursor: pointer` and the `:focus-visible` background for a log row that `tabIndex = 0` makes keyboard-focusable, so it shows no cursor and no focus ring at all; board.css:282 `.tg-group.t-far` (touchdraw.js:506 adds `tg-far`) is the dim colour for a cluster this worker never touched, so a reached and a not-reached cluster look the same; board.css:293 `body.t-open { overflow: hidden }` inside `@media (max-width: 860px)` (touchdraw.js:370,383 add/remove `tg-open` on body) never applies, so on a phone the full-size overlay sits fixed over the page while the page behind it still scrolls; board.css:212 `.tg-c-files-named b` (src_touch.py:516 labels a run's fourth counter plain `files`, which touchdraw.js:324 turns into class `tg-c-files`) never colours that counter orange like its sibling `changed`. Reread at board.css:212,217,282,293 and touchdraw.js:370,383,459,499,506 and src_touch.py:516 on the head commit.
tasks.done_when: grep -c 'tg-pickable\|tg-far\b\|tg-open\|tg-c-files\b' Tools/assetboard/static/board.css reports the four fixed selectors present, and grep -n 't-pickable\|tg-group.t-far\|body.t-open\|tg-c-files-named' Tools/assetboard/static/board.css finds none of the old ones

tasks.title: Add a test case for the i-s-again route state ideas.js can emit
tasks.why: P3. ideas.js:87 builds class `i-s-' + at[n]` and `at[n]` can be `again` (SAID.again = 'Checked again', ideas.js:84), matching ideas.css:46 `.i-route li.i-s-again`. test_assetboard.py:2294 only asserts `.i-route li.i-s-{w}` for `('done', 'next', 'you')`, so a dropped or renamed `again` rule would pass the suite unnoticed. Low cost (one word is drawn with no CSS, cosmetic only) but cheap to close.
tasks.done_when: test_assetboard.py's ideas-route case asserts '.i-route li.i-s-again' is in css alongside done/next/you, and fails if that rule is removed from ideas.css
